purpose: Run the unchanged V19X2 integrated and registered-region spectral commissioning with V19DI direct response arithmetic and V19DK2 deterministic FITS snapshots.

writer.source_background_rule: unchanged CIAO method=sum, bscale_method=asca and exp_origin=pha with response combination disabled
writer.response_rule: V19DH direct exposure/ARF weighting serialized once by the V19DI exact OGIP writer

canonicalization.timing: after source/background/ARF/RMF construction and grouping, immediately before each frozen snapshot and before every spectral fit

decision.pass: Every unchanged V19X2 archive, combination, count, link, canonical snapshot, checksum, integrated-fit and regional-fit gate passes. A separately named all-494-region successor may then be frozen.
decision.scientific_fail: Retain all fit results and stop. Do not alter grouping, band, absorption, redshift, abundance rule, statistic, optimizer, bounds, cell membership, response threshold or canonicalization.
decision.execution_fail: Record the implementation failure. A separately named remediation is permitted only if no spectral outcome was opened.

claim_boundary: V19DL changes only FITS serialization after V19DK2 proved exact array preservation and consumer compatibility.
All V19X2 cell membership, grouping, spectral model, fit sequence, bounds, quality gates and registered regions are inherited exactly.
A pass commissions all-region gas reconstruction; it is not an I4/I5, lensing or gravity result.
No source invariant, lensing, halo, action, gravity parameter or holdout payload is opened.
